Team —

We're starting the annual targets planning window this week. I attached a short framework (2026_targets_framework_v1.pptx) that proposes a "stretch / floor / runway" approach for target setting plus a scenario matrix to capture top-line sensitivity to hiring cadence and pricing changes. The goal is to get leadership-level banding finalized before the holiday break so Finance and GTM can model Q1 cash flow and QBR slides.

Please read the deck and the scenario matrix and reply with: 1) your top two assumptions that would move the stretch target, and 2) any constraints (staffing slots, capital, or regulatory considerations) that must be baked into the floor.

- Dec 12–17: leadership calibration (this thread) — collect assumptions and tags
- Dec 20–21: synthesize bands + publish to Finance (Northbridge)
- Jan 4: extended OKR check-in with all PM/Eng leads to map to targets

Quick asks by EOD Thursday (Dec 17):
- Add comments to scenario_matrix_v2.xlsx in the Drive link below
- Flag any items that require procurement/partner dependencies

I know this is a short window — focus on the high-impact items (pricing, dedicated capacity commitments, and large-headcount hires).

Thanks — Hannah
